preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of potions for each color must be between 1 and 100.
The number of magic tricks M must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in r) and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in g) and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in b)
preconditions.description: The amounts of liquid in each potion must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum of the maximum amounts of liquid among the three colors after applying the magic tricks.
